music/title.desc: Cute, bouncy chiptune adventure loop (Zane Little "Flowerbed Fields").

music/stage1.desc: Energetic retro chiptune action loop, the most laid-back of the three stage tracks (Juhani Junkala "Level 1").

music/stage2.desc: Upbeat, driving chiptune chase loop (Juhani Junkala "Level 2").

music/stage3.desc: Busiest, most intense chiptune loop of the set, for the final stretch (Juhani Junkala "Level 3").

music/win.desc: NES-style triumphant victory fanfare (about 11 s) that resolves on a low final note.

music/lose.desc: Short descending "game over" synth jingle with a held, deflated final note.

music/mayo.desc: Sad-tuba "wah wah wah wahhh" comedic fail jingle.

ambient/sewer.desc: Low cave/sewer hum and air with echoey water drips.

ambient/city.desc: Distant, muffled city traffic rumble under soft wind.

ambient/night.desc: Night rooftop air: gentle wind, faint crickets, very faint far-off city hum.

ambient/mold.desc: Low wet bubbling and gurgling over a deep rumble with occasional slow squelches.

sfx/double_jump.desc: Higher, faster rising chiptune sweep for the second jump.

sfx/slide.desc: Fabric rustle plus a low sliding scrape.

sfx/step1.desc: Light footstep tap on hard floor (variant 1).

sfx/step2.desc: Light footstep tap on hard floor (variant 2).

sfx/stomp.desc: Cartoon boing with a soft thump underneath.

sfx/meow1.desc: Clean synthetic cartoon cat meow (rising then falling).

sfx/hit.desc: Heavy body-punch thud with a small retro damage blip.

sfx/clang.desc: Metal pipe clang with a short ringing tail.

sfx/pickle.desc: Crunchy cucumber bite with a bright chiptune chime on top.

sfx/pie.desc: Whoosh followed by a squishy splat.

sfx/growl.desc: Goofy mouth-made monster growl, pitched down a little.
